speaker: Doctor
text: How would you describe the appearance of the rash on your palms, and have you noticed any scaling or blisters? Additionally, have you been experiencing any joint pain, fever, or fatigue recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your history of caring for livestock and working on a rice farm, have you had any direct contact with soil, animal hides, or specific plants like the castor bean plant or oleander? Also, is the rash on your upper body and face itchy, and does it spread in a specific pattern?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's Disease).

Given the classic triad of a pruritic rash, symmetric loss of sensation on the palms, and specific signs like eyebrow thinning and hypopigmented macules, your condition strongly suggests leprosy. I need to confirm this by reviewing your slit-skin smear results and requesting images of your skin lesions. REQUEST TEST: Slit_Skin_Smear; REQUEST IMAGES: Dermatology_full_body.
